crossRefs.note: He took up his parable, and said, “From Aram has Balak brought me, the king of Moab from the mountains of the East.…
How shall I curse whom God has not cursed? How shall I defy whom Yahweh has not defied?
‘Behold, the people that has come out of Egypt covers the surface of the earth. Now, come curse me them. Perhaps I…
for I will promote you to very great honor, and whatever you say to me I will do. Please come therefore, and curse this…
Balak’s anger burned against Balaam, and he struck his hands together. Balak said to Balaam, “I called you to curse my…
Yes, he loved cursing, and it came to him. He didn’t delight in blessing, and it was far from him.

people.name: Balaam
people.line: A prophet hired to curse Israel but blessed them instead.

people.name: Balak
people.line: King of Moab who hired Balaam to curse Israel.

translations.web: Balak said to Balaam, “What have you done to me? I took you to curse my enemies, and behold, you have blessed them altogether.”
translations.bsb: Then Balak said to Balaam, “What have you done to me? I brought you here to curse my enemies, and behold, you have only blessed them!”
translations.kjv: And Balak said unto Balaam, What hast thou done unto me? I took thee to curse mine enemies, and, behold, thou hast blessed them altogether.
translations.asv: And Balak said unto Balaam, What hast thou done unto me? I took thee to curse mine enemies, and, behold, thou hast blessed them altogether.
